project.name: Swedish Historical HTR Technical Reliability Screening
project.description: Reference-free technical reliability screening of SATRN and Florence-2 on real Swedish witchcraft-trial court records. No ground truth exists for this corpus; no accuracy metric is computed.

experiment.name: Technical reliability screening (60-page stratified sample)
experiment.description: Execution success/failure, timing, GPU memory and output-shape signals only. Segmentation is Florence-2-family; that confound is recorded, not neutralized.
